fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the booking.

fields.name: confirmation_code
fields.description: The human-readable confirmation code for the booking.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The current status of the booking.

fields.name: experience_id
fields.description: The identifier of the booked experience.

fields.name: schedule_id
fields.description: The identifier of the booked schedule entry.

fields.name: guests_count
fields.description: The number of guests included in the booking.

fields.name: total_price
fields.description: The total price of the booking.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the booking pricing.

fields.name: host_payout
fields.description: The amount to be paid out to the host after fees.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the booking was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the booking was last updated.
